local_address.description: IP address the PowerDNS server will listen on for incoming DNS queries

local_port.description: UDP/TCP port to listen on for DNS queries

allow_axfr_ips.description: List of IP addresses permitted to request zone transfers (AXFR). Empty = none.

enable_axfr.description: Enable zone transfers (AXFR). Enable only for trusted secondary servers.

tcp_outgoing_socket.description: TCP outgoing socket port (0 = system default). Rarely needed.

disable_dnssec.description: Disable DNSSEC processing (recommended for authoritative-only servers that don't sign zones)

disable_dns64.description: Disable DNS64 (IPv6 synthesization). Not used in authoritative-only mode.

backends.description: Database backends to load. Each backend defines its own connection type and parameters.

name.description: Backend type: gsqlite3, gmysql, gpgsql, etc.

connection_string.description: Database connection string (e.g., '/path/db.sqlite3' for gsqlite3, 'host=localhost user=... dbname=...' for gmysql/gpgsql)

default_soa_name.description: Default primary nameserver in SOA records if not specified per-zone

default_soa_mail.description: Default responsible email (SOA MNAME) in SOA records — use dot instead of @ (e.g., admin.example.com)

chroot_dir.description: Chroot directory (e.g., '/var/lib/powerdns'). Leave empty to disable chrooting.

setuid_user.description: User to drop privileges to after startup

setgid_group.description: Group to drop privileges to after startup

log_dns_queries.description: Log all incoming DNS queries (use with care for privacy)

max_udp_packet_size.description: Maximum UDP packet size (EDNS0). Typically 4096 for modern clients.

worker_threads.description: Number of worker threads. Set to number of CPU cores for best performance.

max_cache_entries.description: Maximum number of entries in the packet cache (not used heavily in authoritative mode)

max_cache_ttl.description: Maximum TTL (seconds) for cached data (e.g., NSEC/NSEC3 proofs).

api_enabled.description: Enable the PowerDNS API for zone management and monitoring

api_key.description: API authentication key (base64 or strong random string). Required if API is enabled.

api_readonly.description: If true, API operations are read-only (no zone modifications)

include_dir.description: Directory to scan for additional configuration files (*.conf)
